name: Nihiloor — one ability for each opponent, each target bounded by its own tapped creature
notes: "When Nihiloor enters, for each opponent, tap up to one untapped creature you control. When you do, gain control of target creature that player controls with power less than or equal to the tapped creature's power for as long as you control Nihiloor." (2026-10-18, Conor: one pick and one target for each opponent; the site does not tap, the player taps after firing.) Firing it with two opponents makes one ability for each, each with a "Tapped creature" pick (read off the fire-time snapshot, so it must be untapped then) and a target among that opponent's creatures only. Opp A's, with Trained Armodon (3) picked, lists Grizzly Bears but not Craw Wurm (6) or anything of Opp B's; Opp B's, with Gray Ogre (2), lists Llanowar Elves but not Centaur Courser (3). Before, the comparison was a required subtype and both lists were empty.

scryfallData.name: Trained Armodon
scryfallData.flavor_text: These are its last days. Better to grow broad and heavy. Better that the enemy is crushed beneath its carcass.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Centaur Courser
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

scryfallData.name: Llanowar Elves
scryfallData.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

scryfallData.name: Nihiloor
scryfallData.oracle_text:
When Nihiloor enters, for each opponent, tap up to one untapped creature you control. When you do, gain control of target creature that player controls with power less than or equal to the tapped creature's power for as long as you control Nihiloor.
Whenever you attack with a creature an opponent owns, you gain 2 life and that player loses 2 life.
